stops.name: Walchensee
stops.quote: Walchensee (lake) is also called the "Bavarian Caribbean", because of its turquoise-green water.
stops.english: Walchensee (lake) is also called the "Bavarian Caribbean", because of its turquoise-green water.

stops.name: Einsiedl
stops.quote: The villages of Walchensee, Einsiedl, Urfeld and Zwergern lie directly on the shore of the lake.
stops.english: The villages of Walchensee, Einsiedl, Urfeld and Zwergern lie directly on the shore of the lake.

stops.name: Urfeld
stops.quote: One of the most tranquil places on the lake is the traffic-free eastern shore between Urfeld and Niedernach.
stops.english: One of the most tranquil places on the lake is the traffic-free eastern shore between Urfeld and Niedernach.

stops.name: Zwergern
stops.quote: The Zwergern Walchensee peninsula offers another great swimming opportunity – and a magnificent view of the mountains and villages.
stops.english: The Zwergern Walchensee peninsula offers another great swimming opportunity – and a magnificent view of the mountains and villages.

stops.name: Jochberg
stops.quote: The mountains around Walchensee are among Munich's most popular landmarks– such as the Jochberg (1,565 m).
stops.english: The mountains around Walchensee are among Munich's most popular landmarks– such as the Jochberg (1,565 m).

stops.name: Jocheralm
stops.quote: From the top, you have a magnificent view of Kochelsee and Walchensee (lakes), and you can stop for a snack at Jocheralm.
stops.english: From the top, you have a magnificent view of Kochelsee and Walchensee (lakes), and you can stop for a snack at Jocheralm.

stops.name: Herzogstand
stops.quote: Maybe the Herzogstand (mountain) (1,731 m) is an even more popular destination – especially because of the Herzogstand cable car.
stops.english: Maybe the Herzogstand (mountain) (1,731 m) is an even more popular destination – especially because of the Herzogstand cable car.

stops.name: Herzogstand mountain inn
stops.quote: But you can also just sit on the terrace of the Herzogstand mountain inn and enjoy the picturesque view of the surrounding lakes and the Karwendel mountains.
stops.english: But you can also just sit on the terrace of the Herzogstand mountain inn and enjoy the picturesque view of the surrounding lakes and the Karwendel mountains.
